state.task:
Question-answering task over a company handbook.

The handbook is in /task/fixtures/handbook/ (40 documents, HB-01.md to HB-40.md). Each document
has a header line (version, status, effective dates, what it supersedes) and numbered sections;
each section is a passage, cited as "HB-07 §2". Documents can have superseded versions, and
memos can add group exceptions and carve-outs. Use the rule that applies to the situation and
date in the question.

Tools (in your code):
  import sys; sys.path.insert(0, "/task/fixtures")
  from handbook_tools import search, show
  search("lodging limit Geneva", k=5)   # up to k (at most 8) ranked passages, with ids
  show(["HB-07 §2", "HB-12 §3"])        # the named passages in full
Every search result is also saved under /task/workspace/search-results/ (the path is printed in
the result header). You may also read the documents directly.

Questions:
- Q1: What mileage rate applied to a business trip in a private petrol car on 2026-03-15? (answer in cents per km)
- Q2: What is the annual training budget for a regular employee who holds a team-lead role today? (answer in EUR per year)
- Q3: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today? (answer in EUR per night)
- Q4: What is the relocation lump sum for an employee relocating to another country in their third month of employment today? (answer in EUR)
- Q5: What is the home-office equipment allowance for an employee with a medical accessibility plan today? (answer in EUR)
- Q6: What is the purchase approval threshold for a purchase by a regular department today (2026-10-13)? (answer in EUR)

Finish with {"action": "final", "answer": {"answers": [{"question": "Q1", "value": "...",
"citations": ["HB-07 §2", ...]}, ...]}}. Give one entry per question. The value must be the
exact amount; citations must include every passage needed to support it (for example the
rule and any exception or carve-out that applies), not just one passage.
state.step_intent: Find the nightly lodging limit that applies to: What is the nightly lodging limit for a contractor on a business trip to Geneva today?

passages.source: HB-35 §3 | Policy FAQ — Current nightly lodging limit | version: 7 · status: current · effective: 2026-01-15
passages.text: Q: What is the current standard nightly lodging limit? A: 195 EUR per night, as set in HB-05 §2 (effective 2026-05-01). Group exceptions are listed in HB-36.

passages.source: HB-05 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 3 · status: current · effective: 2026-05-01 · supersedes: HB-31
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel is 195 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. This section is reviewed once a year by the finance team together with the policy owner. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation.

passages.source: HB-36 §1 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Purpose | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: This memo lists group exceptions to the nightly lodging limit in HB-05. Costs paid with a company card are reconciled in the same tool as personal claims. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header. Claims are submitted in the expense tool within 30 days of the date the cost was incurred.

passages.source: HB-31 §2 | Travel policy: lodging — Standard nightly lodging limit | version: 2 · status: superseded · effective: 2025-03-01 to the day before 2026-05-01 · superseded by: HB-05
passages.text: The nightly lodging limit for business travel was 155 EUR per night, including taxes and city fees. Where a local agreement sets stricter rules, the stricter rule applies for that location. Audit samples are drawn every quarter, and selected employees are asked for documentation. Employees should keep costs reasonable and book through the approved channels where possible.

passages.source: HB-36 §3 | Memo: nightly lodging limit exceptions — Carve-out | version: 1 · status: current · effective: 2025-03-01
passages.text: The exception above does not apply to contractors; they follow the standard nightly lodging limit in HB-05 §2. Receipts must be attached for every item claimed; photographs of paper receipts are accepted. The policy owner may publish clarifications in the policy FAQ without changing this section. Questions about this section go to the policy owner named in the document header.
